ask: These are grey clay renders of one 3D scene or prop from several cameras. Does any object float above the surface it should rest on, with a visible gap under it?
fix: settle it onto what's under it at its contact points (raea scene lint gives the dy)

ask: These are grey clay renders of one 3D scene or prop from several cameras. Does any object pass through another object, a wall or the floor?
fix: move it clear (raea scene lint names the pair and the depth)

ask: These are grey clay renders. Is any object a blobby, melted or lumpy shape where the real thing has crisp form?
fix: regenerate it from a cleaner reference, or pick the other generator

ask: These are grey clay renders. Is any object just a plain box, ball or cylinder standing in for a more detailed real thing?
fix: build or generate the real thing

ask: These are grey clay renders. Is any object made of parts that don't connect: a handle, a leg or a lid hanging in the air beside the body it belongs to?
fix: regenerate it, or join the parts by script and check it again

ask: These are grey clay renders. Are several copies of one thing identical and evenly spaced in an obviously artificial way?
fix: vary each copy's rotation, scale and wear, or swap some for siblings

ask: These are renders of one 3D scene or prop from several cameras. Is any large surface a flat, uniform default colour with no texture, variation or wear?
fix: give it its real material, with wear where use puts it

ask: These are renders of one 3D scene or prop. Do the surfaces look like shiny uniform plastic or CG rather than their real materials?
fix: roughness and colour variation from real material maps; no uniform gloss

ask: These are renders of one 3D scene or prop. Is anything that should be glass (a window, a bottle, a lens, a screen cover) solid and opaque instead of see-through?
fix: mask the glass by colour and make it transmissive, keeping labels opaque

ask: These are renders of one 3D scene or prop. Is any visible text garbled, tiled or unreadable where it should read, such as a hero object's label or a sign?
fix: replace the label with real text from one invented maker

ask: These are renders of one 3D scene or prop. Is a real brand name or logo visible?
fix: debrand: flatten the logo's texels and normals, or replace it with the invented maker's

ask: These are renders of one 3D scene. Is the scene so dark that important objects are hard to see?
fix: light it from its own sources; raise exposure

ask: These are renders of one 3D scene. Is it washed out, with large areas blown to white?
fix: lower exposure or the brightest light

ask: This sheet shows reference pictures for one set of props that must belong together. Is any picture in a different style from the others: another era, palette, material, lighting or rendering look?
fix: regenerate that reference with the style images and the plan's style paragraph

ask: This sheet shows one reference picture per prop. Does any picture show more than one object, or an object cropped by the edge of its picture?
fix: regenerate it as one whole object, centred, on a plain background

ask: This sheet shows reference pictures for props. Does any picture show a real brand name or logo?
fix: regenerate it with the invented maker named in the prompt

ask: These are frames of camera moves through a 3D scene. Is the camera inside or passing through a wall, a piece of furniture or another solid, so part of the frame is blocked or cut open?
fix: move the path's keys clear (raea scene stage --clearance 0.45 names the frames)

ask: These are frames of camera moves, each shot's start, middle and end. Does any shot lose its subject: cut off, out of frame or hidden at one of its frames?
fix: re-aim the move or retime its keys so the subject stays framed
